build_refcoco_dataset: build a tfds dataset builder for RefCoco with configurable dataset variants like refcoco_unc, refcoco_google, refcocoplus_unc, refcocog_google, refcocog_umd
create_refcoco_config: create a RefCocoConfig specifying dataset variant and dataset partition for the RefCoco dataset builder
test_refcoco_split: test the RefCoco dataset builder splits including train, validation, testA, testB, and test depending on the dataset partition
review_refcoco_generator: review the _generate_examples function that yields image examples with referring expressions and ground truth bounding boxes
summarize_refcoco_features: summarize the RefCoco dataset features including images, objects with bboxes and referring expressions, and coco annotations
